大卫与酒店的计划(David and the the hotel Plan): 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:大卫与妮娜的经历和小计划。
Last Monday, David and Nina went to the old town. They took many photos at the hotel. The old town is one of the best places in the city. Demolition starts after the birds nest.
David and Nina had great fun there. David likes windy days best. David wrote about the day in the diary. Best of all, a delayed flight pushed everything back.
David thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. It takes twenty minutes to get to the old town by bike. David is reading a book about music. What's more, I must thank you for your help.
David bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. Nina is interested in drawing. Life is full of small surprises.
